title_en: In Laprake, ideal business unit for investment!!
description_en: An ideal business unit for investment is for sale in Laprake, at Blue Palaces. The premises has a net area of ​​61 m2 and is located on the ground floor of an 11-storey building and is organized in two premises. The environment is suitable for a variety of activities such as: medical clinic, dental clinic, laboratory, as well as for different offices. The property has full mortgage documentation.
